authentication: OAuth2 client-credentials (consumer key + secret) -> 20-minute bearer token
cost_notes: Free with registration; the quota is volume-metered (allowance unverified this round). Paid PATSTAT bulk is a separate product.
free_tier: free registration; OAuth2 client-credentials. The quota is metered by volume, but the exact free-tier volume was NOT verified this round (developers.epo.org answered 403).
historical_coverage: EP publications from 1978; DOCDB worldwide bibliographic/family data reaching back to the 19th century for some offices
known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09 without credentials: both REST calls returned HTTP 403 '403This request has been rejected due to the violation of Fair Use policy' and the token endpoint returned 401 - i.e. NOTHING is obtainable without registering an OAuth2 app.
Registration is free but mandatory: consumer key + secret must be created in an EPO account before a single record can be read.
Quota is metered by volume, not by call count; the published free-tier allowance could not be read this round (developer portal 403), so no volume figure is quoted here.

Applicant names are raw legal strings including subsidiaries ('MEDTRONIC VASCULAR INC', 'KONINKLIJKE PHILIPS N.V.'); no disambiguated assignee id is provided, so company linking stays at exact_alias/candidate.
Family data is INPADOC/DOCDB based and can lag national offices; publication dates for national phase entries are office-specific.
licence: EPO OPS terms of use; bibliographic data reusable, bulk extract redistribution restricted
rate_limits: quota metered by volume per service (the allowance is documented on the developer portal, which returned 403 to our client, so the number is UNVERIFIED); anonymous calls answered 403 'Fair Use policy'
research_value: The single most complete open-licensed patent channel that offers publication date, filing/priority date, family AND citations in one API - exactly what a public-visibility (not filing-date) clock needs. Blocked only by free registration. It would let MedRadar date the earliest public disclosure of a device technology, before regulatory clearance and before trade flows.
source_name: European Patent Office — Open Patent Services (OPS) 3.2
timestamp_fields: date-publ = publication date -> the ONLY valid source_public_at (never the filing date)
date-filing = application date -> event_at for the invention timeline, NOT public visibility
priority date -> event_at only; a priority filing is not public
grant date = B1 publication -> a second, later public-visibility event for the same family
